summary: Nike declared $0.41/share quarterly dividend, boosting premarket. Stock trades ~$44, down 32% YTD and 65% over 3 years. Faces weak China sales, Converse decline (-35%), and EEOC investigation. Pursuing 'Win Now' restructuring. Next earnings June 25, 2026. Analysts see ~41% upside at consensus target ~$62.
